sentences.text:
Ram Barman vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 September,
2024
 Neutral Citation No. 2024:Mphc-Jbp:45901
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
At Jabalpur

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Pramod Kumar Agrawal
 On The 12 th Of September, 2024
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 39364 of 2024
 Ram Barman
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Shri T.R. Patel - Advocate for the applicant.

Shri C.M. Tiwari - Government Advocate for the respondent/St
 Order

This is the first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.325/2023 registered at Police Station - Garha, District Jabalpur (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Section 376(2)(n) and 506 of IPC.
Applicant is in detention since 06.10.2024.
2. As per the prosecution story, the applicant has committed rape with the prosecutrix by threatening and wielding the knife in her house.
On the basis of aforesaid allegation, Police registered the case against the present applicant under the aforesaid Sections.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated.
He is in jail since 06.10.2023.
It is further submitted that the prosecution story and statement of the prosecutrix recorded before the Trial Court is unnatural.
In this regard, he has drawn the attention of Para 6 of statement of prosecutrix to demonstrate that statement of the prosecutrix is unnatural and unbelievable.
DNA report is negative.
Charge sheet has been filed.
The conclusion of trial will take considerable time.
Therefore, it has been prayed NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:45901 2 MCRC-39364-2024 that the applicant may be released on bail.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for State has opposed the prayer for grant of bail to the applicant.
5. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, bail application under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
7.

However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
